notes.title: UPDATE #6
notes.notes:
[h1]Defense: Abominations v1.9 is now online![/h1]

This version now includes boss fights! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33205027/1e1d75624c11c56ed462dafa654a71f7d2bfb14f.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33205027/33ca57439688eb936230f3bf777b6935862991e6.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33205027/922cc9e7046b5eb6152051e7acedbb855ee7b9ac.gif[/img]

They will appear on wave 25 and are undetectable by your turrets! Fight it 1 vs 1 until you wear down their shields and make them detectable by your turrets so they can deliver the final blow! But be careful, their attacks can destroy your turrets, leaving you vulnerable to the attack of the wave enemies!

New enemies now wander the map off-waves. They will attack you if you wander off too much from the spawn points. These will give special drops in the future.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33205027/08aec53694d9dbfd29a58f5bd31b3e7e36a86f71.gif[/img]

And several other small fixes and additions
[list]
[*] The player can no longer collide with his turrets.
[*] You can now enable or disable vertical sync via the options menu.
[*] Improved path-finding for the enemies. But there are still a couple things work on.
[*] Several other small fixes.
[/list]

[h1]Words from the devs[/h1]

The bosses aren't hard, but if they catch you with a short supply of turrets or at a low level, you are going to suffer. There are three key strategies to defeat them.
[list]
[*]Spread your turrets as much as you can before wave 25 so you can have some room to fight. Otherwise, he could destroy all your turrets with ease and the wave monsters will overwhelm you.
[*]Shoot them as soon as you spot them. The bosses are initially slow, take advantage of the time they take to get to you, damage him as much as you can before he gets into your perimeter.
[*]Manage your stamina, get into his close range and run away when he starts an attack animation. Shoot it while he is attacking.
[/list]

We hope you all enjoy this update. All through the week, we'll be doing balancing changes to the bosses, as well as additions here and there to complement this update, so feel free to post about any bug you may find and we'll fix it asap.

Thanks!

We wish you a happy autumn sale and that you buy so many games that you won't be able to finish them this lifetime :)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/674882d078679411cffcc2fc5a98ec15d7ef96f2.gif[/img]

Time splatter is a small episodic rail shooter game where our protagonist, after touching an ancient monolith, is transported to the times where the black plague transformed people into zombie like creatures and knights protected the land. [Another gif below....]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017571/80c380c8f250ef2aa122d59203415ba09b79edf5.gif[/img]

We hope you can support us with your purchase and keep helping us making games. We are hoping to step up the level of our games and bring you better and larger experiences early next year. But you, mighty players are the ones that will make this possible with your purchases and reviews. 

Check out our other games.

notes.title: Update #2 - Inverted Vertical Axis and Difficulty Balancing Changes
notes.notes:
[h1]Defense: Abominations v1.5.0 is now online[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33205027/6ff2e62f1e986ff3a86e74a61ebdcda170426b08.gif[/img]

A small but no less important update is now available.

[h1]Bug fixes and Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Inverted Vertical Axis.[/b] You can now select to invert the vertical axis via the options menu.
[*][b]Increased Starting Resources.[/b] You can now place more turrets when you spawn.
[*][b]Random Spawn Point.[/b] Now you will randomly spawn in different areas of the lab. You now spawn near pickup areas.
[*][b]Big Enemies Resources.[/b] Re-balanced the resources given by the big enemies.
[*][b]New Pickup Spawn.[/b] A new pickup area is now placed a the lab central area. Where the the default spawn was previously at.
[*][b]Enemies HP.[/b] Re-balanced the rate at which the enemies HP increase.

The result of this update should be for the early waves to be easier now, while the late ones harder. The core strategy is still the same, stack turrets before the large enemies spawn. Don't forget to head to the pickup areas to stock up ammo and resources. The pickups here have more resources than the ones dropped by the enemies.

Thank you for playing!
